title: Shipping Calculator
content: Build shipping calculator widget. Input: country/region selector, zip/postal code input. Calculate button triggers rate lookup. Results: list of shipping options (Standard, Express, Overnight) with prices and estimated delivery dates. Free shipping threshold: "Add $X more for free shipping" progress bar. Selected method: radio selection applies to checkout. Error handling: invalid postal code messaging.

variants.simple: Create shipping cost calculator with method selection.
variants.detailed: Build shipping calculator widget. Input: country/region selector, zip/postal code input. Calculate button triggers rate lookup. Results: list of shipping options (Standard, Express, Overnight) with prices and estimated delivery dates. Free shipping threshold: "Add $X more for free shipping" progress bar. Selected method: radio selection applies to checkout. Error handling: invalid postal code messaging.
variants.advanced: Build comprehensive shipping calculator with real-time rates. Container: bg-gray-50 rounded-lg p-4 or expandable section. Header: "Calculate Shipping" or "Estimate Delivery" with Truck icon. Location inputs: country dropdown (pre-select based on IP geolocation), state/province dropdown (dynamic based on country), zip/postal code input (format validation based on country), city input if required by carrier. "Use My Location" button: auto-fill from browser geolocation. Calculate button: "Get Shipping Rates" primary button, loading spinner while fetching. Rate lookup: call shipping API (UPS, FedEx, USPS, carrier aggregator), pass product dimensions/weight, return available methods. Results display: list of shipping methods as selectable radio cards. Each method: carrier logo if applicable, method name ("Standard Ground", "2-Day Express", "Next Day Air"), estimated delivery range ("Arrives Jan 15-18" or "Delivery by Jan 15"), transit time ("5-7 business days"), price (free highlighted in green, or "$X.XX"), cutoff notice ("Order within 2hr 15min for delivery by [date]"). Free shipping: if threshold exists, progress bar showing "Spend $X more for FREE shipping", or "Qualifies for Free Shipping" badge if met. Selection behavior: clicking option selects it, selected state (ring-2 ring-black), selection stored and passed to checkout, update cart totals to reflect shipping choice. Delivery instructions: optional text input for delivery notes (gate code, leave at door). International shipping: additional fields for customs, estimated duties/taxes calculator, restricted items warning. Express eligibility: if item not eligible for certain speeds (hazmat, oversize), note which methods unavailable. Multiple packages: if order ships in multiple boxes, calculate combined shipping, note "Ships in 2 packages". In-store pickup: include as free option if stores available, show nearby stores with availability. Ship to store: lower cost option if available. Date picker: for gifts, select preferred arrival date, calculate which methods meet date. Scheduled delivery: premium option for specific date/time window. Error states: invalid postal code, no shipping available to location, carrier timeout. Rate expiration: note rates valid for X minutes, refresh button. Mobile: stack layout, collapsible initially. Accessibility: form labeled, rate options as radio group with proper ARIA, delivery dates announced clearly.
